fixed.problem: V-1: there was no single run state. Each project card worked out 'working' from every event of each session, and the header chip, Home and the Overview each built their own words ('Alice is working on "X"' named the agent, not the project). The Sessions list said 'Working on "X" (3 of 7 done)'. The shells read only /health's count, which also counted a plan being drafted. Nothing showed a review, a requested stop, the critic's monthly check or a session waiting to go on.

fixed.how: daemon/run-words.ts (pure) and daemon/run-indicator.ts (reads the store) fold each active session's log incrementally into planning, working, reviewing, between, wrapping, stopping, calibrating or waiting. runText gives at most 80 characters with no id and no USD: 'Quote page · the coder works on "Style the page"', '· the critic checks "X"', '· picks the next task', '· wraps up "X" at its budget', '· stops after "X"', '· then Garden site', 'waiting until 15:40, then it goes on' (also in quiet-hours, refusal and generic forms), and 'Forerunner · the critic's monthly check on known examples' with its explanation for the API key or for the Claude plan. GET /running and the run.changed event (debounced to at most one per second) carry it, and /health gains running. activeSessions no longer counts a plan being drafted. The calibration run is registered with the kill switch (running.stopCalibration). The Sessions list's working row now uses the same words.

Stopping the critic's monthly check (Stop now or Stop all) aborts its run; the job then records the run as stopped, and in the real-daemon calibration case its notification reads as a failed calibration rather than 'stopped by you'. Its wording belongs to the jobs area (src/jobs).

The UI's unit suite runs in Node, so a browser-only failure (a value import that reaches a Node module) blanks every page while vitest stays green. apps/ui/test/browser-imports.test.ts now guards the workspace packages. Playwright with the real Vite build is the other guard and should run before every merge; here it was green only after the fix.
The Sessions list's gist never carried the credential wait's '...; then your session goes on.' sentence. C3-left-8's Sessions-list half passed at once, and its case now guards that.
notes_for_other_areas: GET /running answers RunningView[] {key, sessionId, projectId, projectName, state (planning|working|reviewing|between|wrapping|stopping|calibrating|waiting), what, text, since, stop, cancel, nextProject, explain}. The run.changed event (RUN_CHANGED_EVENT in daemon/run-words.ts; the bus name 'run' belongs to task runs) carries it on /events and in polling, at most once a second. /health.running is {projectName, what, text, waiting} or null.

runText, runFit, runWhat, stopChoices, foldRunEvents and RUN_EVENT_TYPES live in daemon/run-words.ts, which has no store and is safe for the fake daemon. It is NOT safe for the browser build (it reaches node:crypto through task-words.ts). UI code must import only browser-safe files such as daemon/run-wait-words.ts (CANCEL_WAIT_EXPLAIN); apps/ui/test/browser-imports.test.ts fails otherwise.
RunWait has an 'other' form ('<project> · waiting for Claude, then it goes on') for d1109-cred-engine's share and key-month waits. C6 (cred-screens) can give it its own words with a date.

ProjectCardFacts.startsWait (views.ts) and project-status.ts rule 2b: the status line's action kind 'cancel' posts /projects/:id/continuation/cancel. SessionView.waitBlock {state goes_on|starts_again|stopped, text, action cancel|continue, explain, projectId, budgetLeft}. summaryAfterWait rewrites '; then your session goes on.' to '; then it runs at your next Start.'. HumanRequestView.startOffer comes from startOfferOf(change_card, status, projectId): prepared outcomes waits_start, stopping or failed, never hands_off.

compose.ts registers `running` {views, poke, stopCalibration, close} on RuntimeApp. scheduler.requestStart and cancelPending are wrapped only to call poke beside the scheduler's own promise; never make that wrapper async (sync-gate.test.ts). The calibration run is registered with the kill switch and running.stopCalibration aborts it.
Desktop: daemon.rs Health.running (an older daemon gives None). state.rs running_words, window_title and icon_dot; tray.rs with_running_dot; actions.rs STOP_ALL_QUESTION and stopped_words.
